title: Equifacetted polytopes whose facets are products of simplices: The simplicial prism case
summary: We study \emph{prismatical} polytopes, those all of whose facets are combinatorially isomorphic to the simplicial prism $Δ^{d-2}\timesΔ^1$. In dimension three these are exactly the cubical polytopes, so the class sits naturally between simplicial and cubical polytopes. In dimension four, $Δ^2\timesΔ^2$ is the simplest prismatical polytope and we can construct infinitely many by using connected sums.
